notes.title: Update now live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.

This update fixes some bugs/oversights and should improve general performance, including the following issues:

[list]
[*] Journey mode becomes slower/laggier over time.
[*] Bounce bullets causes excessive slowdown.
[/list]
